projects.name: Customer access program
projects.description: Customer access program (Mastercard) is dedicated to ensuring the safety, simplicity and security of Mastercard customer access. It has multiple product/Program under it like Web access gateway (Heracles), Secure access service, Security identity management, Application framework Secure access services – This product plays a pivotal role in managing security polices, authentication, authorization and token generation.it is a light weight, easily scalable microservices and API. These services align master card cloud enablement as well in soil requirement

projects.name: Citi Direct
projects.description: Citi Direct is payment facilitation system of Citibank which supports all payment systems like book transfer, domestic fund transfer, cross-border transfer etc. There are multiple levels of authorization & approvals involved in payment flow system. Project consists of re-writing the Citi Direct application based on Microservices. Transform the TTS technology platform to have Always-On HA capability with independently manageable and high performing micro-services.

projects.name: Tigers

projects.name: RUBY
projects.description: RUBY an in-house platform built to support Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), CCAR, Treasury, and Risk Management globally for Pre-Provision Net Revenue (PPNR), Balance Sheet forecasting and Interest Rate Risk (IRR) management.

projects.name: Operational Risk
projects.description: Op Risk system supports Operational Risk Management functions that include Loss Capture, Risk Capital Reporting and Control functions to ensure that each business has an appropriate control focus and where necessary mandate the modification of in-business or independent control processes. System functionality1 available a) Capture of operational risk event loss data (including Fraud losses) that conforms to the Citigroup Operational Risk Policy b) Operational Risk Capital calculations c) Controls assessment and capture of Risk and Controls Indicators d) Reporting and Data / Scenario analysis tools

projects.name: Earth and Moon – RFB Program
projects.description: The program Earth and moon -The UK Banking Reform Act requires the separation of HBEU’s UK retail and SME operations into ring fenced bank (the RFB). The main aim of the project was to separate out the ring fence (RFB) and NRFB bank. This was a regulatory change mandated by the UK government. All RBWM (Retail banking and Wealth Management) and CMB (Commercial Banking) will fall within the RFB except for few cases where the legislation explicitly prohibits. All GBM (Global Banking and Markets) will fall under Non-Ring Fence Bank. Worked with various teams like payments, authorization, clearing and settlement, core banking, reporting

projects.name: WMS
projects.description: Installing a new fully automated Distributions center which include inbound/outbound, location management, shipping, PO etc.

projects.name: WMS – Implementing a New DC
projects.description: Marks and Spencer (also known as M&S) is a British retailer headquartered in the City of Westminster, London, with over 700 stores in the United Kingdom and over 300 stores spread across more than 40 countries. It specializes in the selling of clothing and luxury food products. This was a large program of 50 M ponds. The task was to install a new Distribution center with the new package red prairie (external vendor - WMS. Package) Customization of Red prairie as per requirement of M&S

projects.name: MCIM Program – Multi Channel inventory management Program
projects.description: Multichannel supply chain encompasses the end-to-end process of getting merchandise. Multichannel inventory program is, managing the inventory across DC, Stores and Dot com ( E-commerce). This was a large program which involves work streams like WMS, TMS, Merchandise, dotcom, Item Inventory, PO etc. The main aim of the project was to manage inventory via different channels Worked on Waterfall and agile. This project was in phases and once the phase was in production, we had created the agile team for the upgrade of the application’s new changes. This was a large project of $ 60 Millions

stores in the United Kingdom and over 300 stores spread across more than 40 countries. It specializes in the selling of clothing and
luxury food products. This was a large program of 50 M ponds.
The task was to install a new Distribution center with the new package red prairie (external vendor - WMS. Package)
Customization of Red prairie as per requirement of M&S

projects/25/name.quote: MCIM Program – Multi Channel inventory management Program

projects/25/description.quote: Multichannel supply chain encompasses the end-to-end process of getting merchandise. Multichannel inventory program is,
managing the inventory across DC, Stores and Dot com ( E-commerce). This was a large program which involves work streams like
WMS, TMS, Merchandise, dotcom, Item Inventory, PO etc.
The main aim of the project was to manage inventory via different channels
Worked on Waterfall and agile. This project was in phases and once the phase was in production, we had created the agile team
for the upgrade of the application’s new changes. This was a large project of $ 60 Millions
